evals.name: exchange-set-rules-s124
evals.prompt: I'm building an S-124 exchange set exporter. According to S-100 5.2.1 and S-124 2.0.0, what's the required folder structure of an exchange set, how should fileName in CATALOG.XML reference the dataset files, and what's the dataset file naming convention for S-124? Cite clauses.
evals.expected_output: Part 17 17-4.2 folder rules (S100_ROOT, CATALOG.XML+CATALOG.SIGN, S-124/DATASET_FILES ...), fileName is a file URI per Part 1 1-4.6 with Table 17-1 example, unique base names, S-124 9.7 naming; cites with pages
assertions: States all content sits under a single top-level S100_ROOT folder with CATALOG.XML and CATALOG.SIGN in it (S-100 Part 17, 17-4.2)
Describes a per-product S-124 subfolder containing DATASET_FILES (and mentions SUPPORT_FILES and/or CATALOGUES)
Explains fileName is a URI (file:/...) per S-100 Part 1 clause 1-4.6 and/or Part 17 Table 17-1
States base dataset filenames must be unique (17-4.3)
Correctly says S-124 9.7 defers to S-100 Part 17 17-4.3 and gives the XXXYYYY + unique code + extension pattern (124 + 4-char producer code)
Cites S-100 Ed 5.2.1 clause numbers and gives page numbers for at least the key claims

evals.name: validate-danish-nw-exchange-set
evals.prompt: Can you validate the exchange set in testdata/danish-nw-examples (2)/danish-nw-examples/exchange-sets/DK-NW-011-26 (under ~/Documents/S-100)? I want to know if it's conformant with S-124 2.0.0 / S-100 5.2. List any problems with the relevant S-158 check IDs where they exist. Write the report to report.md.
evals.expected_output: Structural inspection of CATALOG.XML and the GML, correct handling of bare file:/ fileName, ids/xlinks, metadata, findings linked to S-158 checks with classification, clear separation verified vs judgement
assertions: Inspected both CATALOG.XML and the GML dataset (parsed contents, not just listed files)
Does not report the bare 'file:/124DK00DKNW01126.GML' fileName as an error, or explicitly notes Part 17 Table 17-1 permits it
Reports the dataset identification metadata (e.g. productIdentifier S-124, productEdition 2.0.0, encodingSpecification S-100 Part 10b)
Cites at least two specific S-158 check IDs (e.g. 100_xxxx) with their classification for findings or checks performed
Clearly states what was not verified (e.g. XSD validation against online schemas, signature verification)

evals.name: s111-hdf5-mandatory-metadata
evals.prompt: What root-group metadata attributes are mandatory in an S-111 2.0.0 HDF5 file, and which S-158 checks test them? Then check whether 111GB00_20260511T001500Z_GB3DEVK0_dcf2.h5 in ~/Documents/S-100/testdata/UKHO_S100_Trial_datasets/S-111/S-111_GB_May26/S100_ROOT/S-111/DATASET_FILES has all of them. Put the answer in answer.md.
evals.expected_output: Table of mandatory root attributes from S-111 Table 12.1 (and S-100 10c), check IDs 111_1002/1003 etc., actual comparison against the file
assertions: Lists the mandatory root attributes productSpecification, issueDate, horizontalCRS, the four bounding-box attributes, depthTypeIndex, surfaceCurrentDepth, issueTime and verticalCoordinateBase
Identifies verticalCS, verticalDatumReference and verticalDatum as mandatory when depthTypeIndex = 1 (conditional)
Cites S-111 Table 12-1 (General metadata) and/or S-100 Table 10c-6
Names S-158 check 111_1002 as the check for missing/wrong-type mandatory metadata
Concludes the sample file contains all mandatory attributes (it does)
Checks or reports the HDF5 data types of the attributes (e.g. Float32 bounds, enumeration types)
